events.name: Underground Kitchen, a private dining experience
events.description:
On July 21, step into the heart of the kitchen for Underground Kitchen “Around the World”
We are looking forward to welcoming you to “Around the World” Underground Kitchen - an immersive, multi-course culinary journey inspired by flavors and traditions from across the globe. This special evening will feature OVG Executive Chef Devin Levine alongside Guest Chef Shannon Smith, combining their unique culinary styles to create a one-night-only dining experience filled with bold flavors, refined techniques, and globally inspired storytelling.
Travel through vibrant Egyptian dukkah salad, Sicilian pistachio pesto orecchiette, Israeli hummus im bassar, and richly spiced Indian chicken curry before ending the evening in France with a decadent Tour de France dessert trio.
Each course will be paired with thoughtfully selected wines designed to complement and elevate the experience throughout the night.
Limited seats. Global flavors. One unforgettable evening underground.
Click here to see the full menu
*Proceeds from this event will benefit Food On The Move.
Experience Elements provided by Anybody’s Guest and Apropo

ABOUT CHEF SHANNON SMITH
Chef Shannon Smith is a Tulsa-based chef, author, storyteller, and world traveler whose work is inspired by more than 50 countries and the people she has met along the way. Known for her intimate dining experiences and globally inspired cuisine, Shannon blends food, travel, and connection into every dish she creates.
ABOUT EXECUTIVE CHEF DEVIN LEVINE
Chef Devin Levine is a 52-year veteran in the food and hospitality industry, currently executive chef for the Oak View Group managed BOK Center and the Arvest Convention Center.
Prior to joining OVG, Chef Levine was executive chef at Southern Hills Country Club for 34 years which was listed as a top Platinum Club ranking15th in the United States. Chef Levine was also executive chef at the Bank of Oklahoma Executive Dining Room for 10 years and began his culinary career at the Camelot Hotel in Tulsa in 1972.
Chef Levine is a certified executive chef (CEC) through the American Culinary Federation (ACF) and has been voted chef of the year three times and received the “Man of Distinction” award by the Tulsa Business & Legal News in 2013.

*Fair Market Value $125

events.name: Shut up & Write: Broken Arrow
events.description:
Shut Up & Write hosts free in-person and online writing events for writers all over the world. Our goal is to ensure that every writer, regardless of genre or skill level, has access to the community, accountability, and resources they need to be successful in their personal writing goals. Our events use our proven formula: a few minutes of introductions, an hour of focused writing, and a final check-in to share the hour's progress.

What to Expect
RSVP and please arrive 10–15 minutes early to get settled at an in-person event. Our host will lead introductions and then everyone will write for a quiet, focused period of time.

Afterward, we’ll have an optional time to chat and get to know each other. Members often talk about their successes and challenges as writers. Our events are a safe space for writers to work on their craft. No one will read or critique your writing.
For more information about our events, visit https://shutupwrite.com.

Being Late is Okay: Just show up and get settled, then check in with me after the session. (I’ll be the person with the Shut Up & Write sign.) If you are on time, please be willing to make room for any friendly latecomers.

What Should I Bring?
Whatever you need to be able to write!
Bring earbuds/earplugs if you want to block the cafe’s ambient music or the occasional conversation by other patrons.

events.name: History and Mystery Guided Tour of Turkey Mountain
events.description:
A hiking tour with several stops to talk about the history of Turkey Mountain sprinkled with mystery, lore, future plans, and maybe bigfoot.
**** NO REFUNDS within 7 days of the event unless cancelled due to weather ****
Join us for a two and a half hour guided hike with River Parks’ resident Turkey Mountain Expert and former professional archaeologist, Ryan Howell. The hike will include multiple stops to discuss Turkey Mountain’s role in the oil boom of Tulsa and touch on rumors of bigfoot, buried Spanish Gold, unsolved murders, and Vikings. We will also talk about Turkey Mountain’s future and a Master Plan to restore the ecology of the area and make the trails more sustainable. You’ll learn more about Turkey than you ever wanted to know!
This hike can be strenuous in places and is NOT recommended for people with mobility issues or children under 14. The hike will last about 2 and 1/2 hours. If you cannot walk for 2.5 miles and stay on your feet for most of that time, this tour will be extremely difficult for you.
Limit of 4 tickets per order. We can only have about 12 people in each group hike so tickets are limited and must be purchased in advance. NO TICKETS will be sold the day of or onsite.
**** NO REFUNDS within 7 days of the event unless cancelled due to weather **** ****
In case of inclement weather, we will move the hike day and issue refunds for those who can't make it on the alternative date.
100% of Proceeds Benefit Tulsa's Turkey Mountain and River Parks.
